description: Integrate Congress.gov voting records and bill summaries data, enabling legislation search, rep page enhancements, and template-to-bill linking.

epics.title: Shared Infrastructure
epics.description: Create reusable API wrappers, XML parsers, and shared types for Congress data integration

stories.title: Congress.gov API wrapper
stories.description: As a developer, I want a typed client for Congress.gov API so that I can fetch House votes and bill data with proper error handling and rate limiting.
acceptanceCriteria: Client accepts API key via options parameter (caller supplies from config/env)
All API responses are typed with TypeScript interfaces
Rate limiting respects 5,000 requests/hour limit with 100ms minimum delay
Errors are caught and wrapped with descriptive messages
Supports pagination for list endpoints
Exports functions for: listHouseVotes, getHouseVote, listBills, getBill, getBillSummaries

stories.title: Senate.gov XML parser
stories.description: As a developer, I want to parse Senate.gov vote XML files so that I can sync Senate voting records to the database.
acceptanceCriteria: Fetches vote menu XML to get list of votes in a session
Fetches individual vote XML for detailed member positions
Parses vote metadata: number, date, question, result, tally
Parses member positions: name, party, state, vote cast, LIS ID
Uses fast-xml-parser for XML parsing
Handles network errors gracefully
Returns LIS-shaped parsed types (ParsedSenateVote/SenateVoteMember); mapping to shared Vote/MemberVote types occurs in the Senate vote fetcher

stories.title: Shared types for legislation data
stories.description: As a developer, I want shared TypeScript types for votes, bills, and member positions so that I have consistent data structures across the codebase.
acceptanceCriteria: Vote type includes: id, rollCall, chamber, congress, session, date, question, result, billNumber, billTitle, sourceUrl
MemberVote type includes: voteId, bioguideId, position (yea/nay/not_voting/present)
Bill type includes: billNumber, billType, congress, title, summary, status, subjects, introducedDate, latestActionDate, sponsorBioguideId
BillSummary type for CRS summaries
Chamber union type: 'house' | 'senate'
VotePosition union type: 'yea' | 'nay' | 'not_voting' | 'present'
Types are exported and importable from @/lib/types/legislation

stories.title: Bill number utilities
stories.description: As a developer, I want utility functions for parsing and normalizing bill numbers so that I can handle various input formats consistently.
acceptanceCriteria: normalizeBillNumber() converts variants to standard format (H.R.1234, S.567, etc.)
parseBillNumber() extracts type and number from bill number string (e.g., 'H.R.1234' -> {type: 'hr', number: 1234})
parseBillId() parses URL-friendly IDs like 'hr1234' to structured data
toBillId() converts structured data to URL-friendly format
Handles all bill types: hr, s, hjres, sjres, hconres, sconres, hres, sres
Invalid inputs return null or throw descriptive errors
Case-insensitive parsing

stories.title: Unit tests for shared infrastructure
stories.description: As a developer, I want comprehensive unit tests for the API wrapper, XML parser, and utilities so that I can trust these foundational components.
acceptanceCriteria: Congress API wrapper tests mock HTTP responses and verify typed outputs
Senate XML parser tests use fixture files with real XML structure
Bill utils tests cover all normalization variants and edge cases
Error handling paths are tested
Rate limiting behavior is verified
All tests pass with pnpm test

epics.title: Voting Records Data Layer
epics.description: Create database schema, sync scripts, and queries for House and Senate voting records

stories.title: Database schema for votes
stories.description: As a developer, I want database tables for votes and member positions so that I can store synced voting records.
acceptanceCriteria: votes table with: id (uuid), rollCall (int), chamber (varchar), congress (int), session (int), date (date), question (text), result (varchar), billNumber (varchar nullable), billTitle (text nullable), billSubjects (json nullable), sourceUrl (text), createdAt (timestamp)
memberVotes table with: voteId (uuid FK), bioguideId (varchar FK to legislators), position (varchar)
Composite primary key on memberVotes (voteId, bioguideId)
Unique constraint on votes (chamber, congress, session, rollCall)
Index on votes (chamber, congress)
Index on memberVotes (bioguideId)
Types exported: Vote, NewVote, MemberVote, NewMemberVote
Migration runs successfully with pnpm db:push

stories.title: House vote fetcher
stories.description: As a developer, I want to fetch House votes from Congress.gov API so that I can populate the votes database.
acceptanceCriteria: Fetches vote list for current Congress and session
Fetches individual vote details including member positions
Transforms API response to database schema format
Handles pagination for vote lists
Extracts bill information when vote is on a bill
Returns array of Vote + MemberVote[] tuples ready for database insert

stories.title: Senate vote fetcher
stories.description: As a developer, I want to fetch Senate votes from Senate.gov XML so that I can populate the votes database with Senate data.
acceptanceCriteria: Fetches vote menu XML to enumerate all votes in session
Fetches individual vote XML for each vote
Parses member positions including handling of LIS member IDs
Maps LIS member IDs to bioguideIds using legislators table
Transforms XML data to database schema format
Returns array of Vote + MemberVote[] tuples ready for database insert

stories.title: Vote sync script
stories.description: As a developer, I want a sync script that upserts votes from both chambers so that I can keep the database current.
acceptanceCriteria: Script runs with: pnpm sync:votes
Fetches House votes from Congress.gov API
Fetches Senate votes from Senate.gov XML
Upserts votes and member positions using ON CONFLICT
Logs progress: fetching, parsing, upserting counts
Handles partial failures gracefully (continues on single vote error)
Respects rate limits with configurable delay
Exits with non-zero code on fatal errors
Supports --congress flag to specify which Congress to sync (default: current)

stories.title: GitHub Action for vote sync
stories.description: As a maintainer, I want vote sync to run automatically so that voting records stay current.
acceptanceCriteria: Added as step in .github/workflows/refresh-data.yml
Runs after legislators import step
Uses CONGRESS_API_KEY secret
Uses DATABASE_URL secret
Logs sync results
Workflow continues on non-fatal sync errors

stories.title: Vote database queries
stories.description: As a developer, I want query functions for votes so that I can display voting records on rep pages and vote detail pages.
acceptanceCriteria: getVotesByMember(bioguideId, options) returns paginated votes with position
getVoteById(chamber, congress, session, rollCall) returns vote with all member positions
getVoteStats(bioguideId) returns vote count by position
Queries use proper JOINs, no N+1 queries
Options support: limit, offset, chamber filter
Returns typed results matching Vote and MemberVote types

epics.title: Bill Summaries Data Layer
epics.description: Create database schema, bidirectional sync scripts, and queries for bill data

stories.title: Database schema for bills
stories.description: As a developer, I want database tables for bills and sync cursors so that I can store synced bill data and track sync progress.
acceptanceCriteria: bills table with: id (uuid), billNumber (varchar), billType (varchar), congress (int), title (text), summary (text nullable), status (varchar), subjects (json), introducedDate (date), latestActionDate (date), latestActionText (text), sponsorBioguideId (varchar FK to legislators), congressGovUrl (text), createdAt (timestamp), updatedAt (timestamp)
syncCursors table with: id (varchar PK), cursor (text), oldestCongress (int nullable), newestCongress (int nullable), updatedAt (timestamp)
Unique constraint on bills (congress, billType, billNumber)
Index on bills (sponsorBioguideId)
Index on bills (congress, latestActionDate)
Types exported: Bill, NewBill, SyncCursor, NewSyncCursor
Migration runs successfully with pnpm db:push

stories.title: Bill fetcher from Congress.gov
stories.description: As a developer, I want to fetch bills from Congress.gov API so that I can populate the bills database.
acceptanceCriteria: Fetches bill list with pagination support
Supports fromDateTime parameter for incremental sync
Fetches individual bill details including summary
Transforms API response to database schema format
Extracts sponsor bioguideId from bill data
Handles bills without summaries (CRS summaries not always available)
Returns array of Bill objects ready for database insert

stories.title: Forward sync for new bills
stories.description: As a developer, I want to sync new/updated bills since the last sync so that the database stays current with minimal API calls.
acceptanceCriteria: Reads last sync timestamp from syncCursors table
Fetches bills updated since that timestamp using fromDateTime
Upserts new/updated bills to database
Updates syncCursors with new timestamp after successful sync
Handles empty result set (no new bills)
Logs count of bills synced

stories.title: Backward sync for historical backfill
stories.description: As a developer, I want to backfill historical bills so that I can build a complete dataset over time without hitting rate limits.
acceptanceCriteria: Reads oldest synced Congress from syncCursors table
Fetches bills from older Congresses working backwards
Processes in batches of ~2000-3000 bills per run
Respects rate limits with 100ms delay between requests
Tracks coverage: which Congresses are fully synced
Updates syncCursors with oldestCongress after each batch
Self-adjusts: no-op when all target Congresses are covered
Target: Current Congress + 2 previous (117th, 118th, 119th)

stories.title: Bill sync script with direction flag
stories.description: As a developer, I want a sync script that supports both forward and backward sync so that I can run the appropriate sync direction.
acceptanceCriteria: Script runs with: pnpm sync:bills --direction forward
Script runs with: pnpm sync:bills --direction backward
Forward mode: incremental sync of new/updated bills
Backward mode: historical backfill of older bills
Logs progress: direction, Congress being synced, bill counts
Handles partial failures gracefully
Respects rate limits in both modes
Exits with non-zero code on fatal errors

stories.title: GitHub Action for daily bill sync
stories.description: As a maintainer, I want forward bill sync to run daily so that new bills are captured automatically.
acceptanceCriteria: Added as step in .github/workflows/refresh-data.yml
Runs pnpm sync:bills --direction forward
Uses CONGRESS_API_KEY secret
Uses DATABASE_URL secret
Runs after vote sync step
Logs sync results

stories.title: GitHub Action for bill backfill
stories.description: As a maintainer, I want a separate workflow for historical bill backfill so that I can aggressively backfill initially then taper.
acceptanceCriteria: New workflow: .github/workflows/backfill-bills.yml
Initially runs every 4 hours: cron '0 */4 * * *'
Runs pnpm sync:bills --direction backward
Uses CONGRESS_API_KEY and DATABASE_URL secrets
Comments indicate plan to reduce frequency after initial backfill
Can be manually triggered with workflow_dispatch

stories.title: Bill database queries
stories.description: As a developer, I want query functions for bills so that I can display bill data on pages.
acceptanceCriteria: getBillsByMember(bioguideId, options) returns paginated bills for a sponsor
getBillById(congress, billType, billNumber) returns single bill with full details
searchBills(query, options) performs full-text search on title/summary
getBillsBySubject(subject, options) filters by subject tag
Options support: limit, offset, status filter, congress filter
Queries use proper indexes, no N+1 queries
Returns typed results matching Bill type

epics.title: Rep Page Enhancements
epics.description: Add voting records and sponsored bills sections to representative profile pages

stories.title: VotingRecord component
stories.description: As a user, I want to see how my representative voted so that I can understand their positions on issues.
acceptanceCriteria: Displays list of recent votes for the representative
Each vote shows: date, question, result, rep's position (Yea/Nay/etc.)
Position displayed as colored badge (green=Yea, red=Nay, gray=Not Voting)
Links to vote detail page (/vote/chamber/congress/rollCall)
Links to related bill when available
Shows 'No recorded votes' message when empty
Responsive design for mobile

stories.title: SponsoredBills component
stories.description: As a user, I want to see bills my representative has sponsored so that I can understand their legislative priorities.
acceptanceCriteria: Displays list of bills sponsored by the representative
Each bill shows: bill number, title, status, introduced date
Status displayed as badge with color coding
Summary shown truncated with expand option
Links to bill detail page (/legislation/billId)
Links to Congress.gov for full text
Shows 'No sponsored bills' message when empty
Responsive design for mobile

stories.title: Rep page tabbed sections
stories.description: As a user, I want tabbed navigation on rep pages so that I can easily switch between contact info, votes, and bills.
acceptanceCriteria: Rep page has three tabs: Contact, Voting Record, Sponsored Bills
Default tab is Contact (preserves existing behavior)
Tab state preserved in URL hash (#votes, #bills)
Tab switching is instant (no page reload)
VotingRecord component loads in Voting Record tab
SponsoredBills component loads in Sponsored Bills tab
Tab counts shown (e.g., 'Votes (142)', 'Bills (23)')
Accessible: keyboard navigation, ARIA labels

stories.title: Filter controls for votes and bills
stories.description: As a user, I want to filter votes and bills so that I can find specific topics or types.
acceptanceCriteria: VotingRecord has filter dropdown for topic/subject
SponsoredBills has filter dropdown for status (introduced, passed, signed)
SponsoredBills has filter dropdown for subject
Filters update list without page reload
Clear filters button when filters are active
Filter state not persisted in URL (resets on page load)

epics.title: Legislation Search UI
epics.description: Create browse/search pages for legislation with vote breakdowns and rep position displays

stories.title: Legislation index page
stories.description: As a user, I want to browse and search legislation so that I can find bills I care about.
acceptanceCriteria: Page at /legislation displays searchable list of bills
Search input filters by bill number and title
Topic/subject dropdown filters results
Congress dropdown filters by Congress (default: current)
Results show: bill number, title, status, latest action date
Pagination or infinite scroll for large result sets
Empty state with helpful message
URL params for search/filters (?q=, ?subject=, ?congress=)
Shareable URLs preserve filter state

stories.title: Bill detail page
stories.description: As a user, I want to see full details about a bill so that I can understand what it does.
acceptanceCriteria: Page at /legislation/[billId] (e.g., /legislation/hr1234)
Displays: bill number, title, status, introduced date
Shows CRS summary when available
Shows 'Summary not available' placeholder when missing
Links to sponsor's rep page
Lists subject tags
Link to Congress.gov for full text
Links to associated votes when applicable
Handles invalid billId with 404 page

stories.title: Vote detail page
stories.description: As a user, I want to see detailed vote results so that I know who voted which way.
acceptanceCriteria: Page at /vote/[...path] handles /vote/house/119/123 format
Displays: vote question, date, result, tally
Links to related bill when available
Links to official source (Congress.gov or Senate.gov)
Includes VoteBreakdown component (party split)
Includes VoterList component (Yea/Nay columns)
Handles invalid vote path with 404 page

stories.title: VoteBreakdown component
stories.description: As a user, I want to see a visual party breakdown of a vote so that I quickly understand the partisan split.
acceptanceCriteria: Horizontal stacked bar showing Yea/Nay proportions
Color-coded by party (D=blue, R=red, I=purple or gray)
Shows counts: 'Democrats: 200 Yea, 10 Nay'
Shows percentages on hover
Accessible: screen reader text describes breakdown
Responsive: works on mobile widths

stories.title: VoterList component
stories.description: As a user, I want to see lists of who voted Yea and Nay so that I can find specific representatives.
acceptanceCriteria: Two-column layout: Yea on left, Nay on right
Each rep shows: photo (or placeholder), name, party, state
Clicking rep links to their profile page
State filter dropdown narrows displayed reps
Party filter dropdown narrows displayed reps
Not Voting and Present shown in separate collapsed section
Count headers: 'Yea (230)', 'Nay (198)'
Responsive: stacks columns on mobile

stories.title: Your reps voted banner
stories.description: As a user with a saved district, I want to see how my reps voted on a bill so that I can quickly understand their positions.
acceptanceCriteria: Banner appears on vote detail page when user has saved district
Shows each of user's reps with their vote position
Example: 'Your representatives: Rep. Smith (D) voted Yea, Sen. Jones (R) voted Nay'
Links to each rep's profile page
Reads saved district from localStorage or user session
Banner hidden when no district saved
Prominent placement at top of vote breakdown

stories.title: Template CTAs on legislation pages
stories.description: As a user, I want to find or create templates about a bill so that I can easily contact my representatives.
acceptanceCriteria: Bill detail page has 'See templates for this bill' button
Button links to /templates?bill=billNumber
Bill detail page has 'Create a template for this bill' button
Button links to /templates/new?bill=billNumber
Vote detail page has same buttons linking via bill number
Buttons styled consistently with existing CTAs

stories.title: Navigation update for legislation
stories.description: As a user, I want legislation in the main navigation so that I can discover and access legislative data.
acceptanceCriteria: Header navigation includes 'Legislation' link
Link points to /legislation
Positioned appropriately with existing nav items
Active state when on /legislation or subpages
Works on both desktop and mobile nav

epics.title: Template Bill Linking UI
epics.description: Enable linking templates to bills with autocomplete picker, auto-detection, and filtering

stories.title: Schema update for linked bills
stories.description: As a developer, I want a linkedBillNumbers field on templates so that I can associate templates with legislation.
acceptanceCriteria: templates table has linkedBillNumbers column (json, string array, nullable)
Default value is empty array []
Migration runs successfully with pnpm db:push
Template type updated to include linkedBillNumbers
Existing templates have null or [] for linkedBillNumbers

stories.title: BillPicker autocomplete component
stories.description: As a template author, I want to search and select bills so that I can link my template to relevant legislation.
acceptanceCriteria: Text input with autocomplete dropdown
Searches bills by number and title as user types
Dropdown shows bill number, title (truncated), Congress
Selecting a bill adds it to linked list
Multi-select: can add multiple bills
Selected bills shown as removable tags/chips
Debounced search to avoid excessive API calls
Loading state while searching
No results state with helpful message

stories.title: Template form integration
stories.description: As a template author, I want the bill picker in create/edit forms so that I can link bills when writing templates.
acceptanceCriteria: BillPicker appears on template create form (/templates/new)
BillPicker appears on template edit form (if exists)
Form submission includes linkedBillNumbers in payload
API route handles linkedBillNumbers on create/update
Existing linked bills pre-populated when editing
Optional field - form submits successfully without linked bills

stories.title: Auto-detection of bill numbers
stories.description: As a template author, I want the system to detect bill numbers in my text so that I don't forget to link mentioned bills.
acceptanceCriteria: detectBillNumbers(text) function returns array of found bill numbers
Regex patterns match all bill types (H.R., S., H.J.Res., etc.)
On template body blur, detected bills compared to linked bills
Toast/notice shown for unlinked detected bills
Toast has 'Link it' action to add to linked list
Toast has 'Dismiss' to ignore suggestion
Previously dismissed suggestions not re-shown in same session

stories.title: Filter templates by bill
stories.description: As a user, I want to find templates about a specific bill so that I can use or adapt them for my letter.
acceptanceCriteria: /templates?bill=H.R.1234 filters to templates linked to that bill
Bill context banner shows when filtered: 'Showing templates for H.R.1234: [Title]'
Banner has 'Clear filter' action
Zero results shows: 'No templates for this bill yet' with create CTA
Template queries updated to filter by linkedBillNumbers
Normalized bill number matching (hr1234 matches H.R.1234)

stories.title: Pre-fill bill on template creation
stories.description: As a user coming from a bill page, I want the bill pre-selected when creating a template so that I don't have to search for it again.
acceptanceCriteria: /templates/new?bill=H.R.1234 pre-selects the bill in BillPicker
Bill appears in linked bills list on page load
Bill info fetched and displayed (number + title)
User can remove pre-selected bill if desired
Invalid bill number handled gracefully (ignored, logged)
Works with URL-friendly format (hr1234) and standard format (H.R.1234)

verification: pnpm sync:bills --direction forward runs without errors
pnpm sync:bills --direction backward runs without errors
Rep pages show voting history tab
Rep pages show sponsored bills tab
Templates can be linked to bills
